name: The Queen's Gambit
description: The gold standard of classical chess. White plays 1. d4 and immediately sacrifices the c4 flank pawn to gain complete, permanent control of the center with pawns on d4 and e4.

steps.title: Claim d4
steps.explanation: We stake a permanent central claim protected by our Queen.

steps.title: Black Responds Symmetrically
steps.explanation: Black controls their side of the center.

steps.title: The Queen's Gambit!
steps.explanation: We offer our c-pawn! If Black takes (2... dxc4 - Accepted), they give up the center and we easily recover the pawn with e4 + Bxc4.

steps.title: Queen's Gambit Declined
steps.explanation: Black holds the center firmly with e6.

steps.title: Pressure d5
steps.explanation: Develop with power! We add a second piece putting direct pressure on Black's d5 center pawn.

steps.title: Black Defends d5
steps.explanation: Black adds their knight to protect d5.

steps.title: Pin the Defender!
steps.explanation: The killer pin! Our dark-squared bishop pins Black's knight to their queen, destroying their defense of the d5 pawn.
